verses.original: נִבְחָ֣ר שֵׁ֭ם מֵעֹ֣שֶׁר רָ֑ב מִכֶּ֥סֶף וּ֝מִזָּהָ֗ב חֵ֣ן טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: niḇ·ḥār šēm mê·‘ō·šer rāḇ mik·ke·sep̄ ū·miz·zā·hāḇ ḥên ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: A good name is more desirable than great riches favor is better than silver and gold
verses.literalPt: Mais vale a escolha dum bom nome do que as grandes riquezas; e melhor é a estima do que a prata e o ouro.

verses.original: עָשִׁ֣יר וָרָ֣שׁ נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ עֹשֵׂ֖ה כֻלָּ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·šîr wā·rāš nip̄·gā·šū ‘ō·śêh ḵul·lām Yah·weh
verses.literal: The rich and the poor have this in common The LORD is Maker of them all
verses.literalPt: O rico e o pobre se encontram; Jeová é quem faz tanto um como outro.

verses.original: עָר֤וּם׀ רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה וְיִסָּתֵר וּ֝פְתָיִ֗ים עָבְר֥וּ וְֽנֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·rūm rā·’āh rā·‘āh wə·yis·så̄·ṯēr ū·p̄ə·ṯā·yîm ‘ā·ḇə·rū wə·ne·‘ĕ·nā·šū
verses.literal: The prudent see danger and take cover but the simple keep going and suffer the consequences
verses.literalPt: O homem prudente vê o mal e esconde-se; os simples passam adiante e recebem dano.

verses.original: עֵ֣קֶב עֲ֭נָוָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְכָב֣וֹד וְחַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·qeḇ ‘ă·nā·wāh yir·’aṯ Yah·weh ‘ō·šer wə·ḵā·ḇō·wḏ wə·ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: The rewards of humility and the fear of the LORD are wealth and honor and life
verses.literalPt: A recompensa da humildade e do temor a Jeová é a riqueza, a honra e a vida.

verses.original: צִנִּ֣ים פַּ֭חִים בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עִקֵּ֑שׁ שׁוֹמֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשׁ֗וֹ יִרְחַ֥ק מֵהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ṣin·nîm pa·ḥîm bə·ḏe·reḵ ‘iq·qêš šō·w·mêr nap̄·šōw yir·ḥaq mê·hem
verses.literal: Thorns and snares lie on the path of the perverse he who guards his soul stays far from them
verses.literalPt: Espinhos e laços acham-se no caminho do perverso; quem guarda a sua alma afastar-se-á deles.

verses.original: חֲנֹ֣ךְ לַ֭נַּעַר עַל־ פִּ֣י דַרְכּ֑וֹ גַּ֥ם כִּֽי־ יַ֝זְקִ֗ין לֹֽא־ יָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·nōḵ lan·na·‘ar ‘al- pî ḏar·kōw gam kî- yaz·qîn lō- yā·sūr mim·men·nāh
verses.literal: Train up a child in the way he should go and when he is old he will not depart from it
verses.literalPt: Educa a criança no caminho em que deve andar, e ainda quando for velho não se desviará dele.

verses.original: עָ֭שִׁיר בְּרָשִׁ֣ים יִמְשׁ֑וֹל וְעֶ֥בֶד לֹ֝וֶ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ מַלְוֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·šîr bə·rā·šîm yim·šō·wl wə·‘e·ḇeḏ lō·weh lə·’îš mal·weh
verses.literal: The rich rule over the poor and the borrower . . . is slave to the lender
verses.literalPt: O rico domina sobre os pobres; e quem toma emprestado servo é do que lhe empresta.

verses.original: זוֹרֵ֣עַ עַ֭וְלָה יִקְצוֹר אָ֑וֶן וְשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָת֣וֹ יִכְלֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: zō·w·rê·a‘ ‘aw·lāh yiq·ṣōr ’ā·wen wə·šê·ḇeṭ ‘eḇ·rā·ṯōw yiḵ·leh
verses.literal: He who sows injustice will reap disaster . . . and the rod of his fury will be destroyed
verses.literalPt: Aquele que semeia a iniquidade colherá males; E a vara da sua indignação se acabará.

verses.original: טֽוֹב־ עַ֭יִן ה֣וּא יְבֹרָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־ נָתַ֖ן מִלַּחְמ֣וֹ לַדָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: ṭō·wḇ- ‘a·yin hū yə·ḇō·rāḵ kî- nā·ṯan mil·laḥ·mōw lad·dāl
verses.literal: A generous man . . . . . . will be blessed for he shares his bread with the poor
verses.literalPt: Quem é caritativo será abençoado, porque dá do seu pão ao pobre.

verses.original: גָּ֣רֵֽשׁ לֵ֭ץ וְיֵצֵ֣א מָד֑וֹן וְ֝יִשְׁבֹּ֗ת דִּ֣ין וְקָלֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: gā·rêš lêṣ wə·yê·ṣê mā·ḏō·wn wə·yiš·bōṯ dîn wə·qā·lō·wn
verses.literal: Drive out the mocker and conflict will depart even quarreling and insults will cease
verses.literalPt: Lança fora o escarnecedor, e com ele se irá a contenda; cessarão a rixa e a ignomínia.

verses.original: אֹהֵ֥ב טְהוֹר לֵ֑ב חֵ֥ן שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו רֵעֵ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·hêḇ ṭə·hōr lêḇ ḥên śə·p̲ā·t̲āyw rê·‘ê·hū me·leḵ
verses.literal: He who loves a pure heart . . . and gracious lips will have the king for a friend
verses.literalPt: Quem ama a pureza do coração e tem graça nos seus lábios, desse será amigo o rei.

verses.original: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה נָ֣צְרוּ דָ֑עַת וַ֝יְסַלֵּ֗ף דִּבְרֵ֥י בֹגֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·nê Yah·weh nā·ṣə·rū ḏā·‘aṯ way·sal·lêp̄ diḇ·rê ḇō·ḡêḏ
verses.literal: The LORD’s eyes keep watch over knowledge but He frustrates the words of the faithless
verses.literalPt: Os olhos de Jeová conservam o que tem conhecimento, mas ele transtorna as palavras do prevaricador.

verses.original: אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל אֲרִ֣י בַח֑וּץ בְּת֥וֹךְ רְ֝חֹב֗וֹת אֵֽרָצֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·mar ‘ā·ṣêl ’ă·rî ḇa·ḥūṣ bə·ṯō·wḵ rə·ḥō·ḇō·wṯ ’ê·rā·ṣê·aḥ
verses.literal: The slacker says There is a lion outside I will be slain in the streets
verses.literalPt: O preguiçoso diz: Há um leão lá fora; serei morto no meio das ruas.

verses.original: שׁוּחָ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקָּה פִּ֣י זָר֑וֹת זְע֥וּם יְ֝הוָ֗ה יִפּוֹל שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: šū·ḥāh ‘ă·muq·qāh pî zā·rō·wṯ zə·‘ūm Yah·weh yip·pōl šām
verses.literal: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit he who is under the wrath of the LORD will fall into it
verses.literalPt: Cova profunda é a boca das mulheres estranhas; quem é odiado de Jeová cairá nela.

verses.original: אִ֭וֶּלֶת קְשׁוּרָ֣ה בְלֶב־ נָ֑עַר שֵׁ֥בֶט מ֝וּסָ֗ר יַרְחִיקֶ֥נָּה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’iw·we·leṯ qə·šū·rāh ḇə·leḇ- nā·‘ar šê·ḇeṭ mū·sār yar·ḥî·qen·nāh mim·men·nū
verses.literal: Foolishness is bound up in the heart of a child but the rod of discipline drives it far from him
verses.literalPt: A estultícia está ligada ao coração da criança, Mas a vara da correção a afastará dela.

verses.original: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל לְהַרְבּ֣וֹת ל֑וֹ נֹתֵ֥ן לְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר אַךְ־ לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·šêq dāl lə·har·bō·wṯ lōw nō·ṯên lə·‘ā·šîr ’aḵ- lə·maḥ·sō·wr
verses.literal: Oppressing the poor to enrich oneself or giving gifts to the rich will surely lead to poverty
verses.literalPt: Quem, para aumentar o seu lucro, oprime ao pobre e dá ao rico só consegue a penúria.

verses.original: הַ֥ט אָזְנְךָ֗ וּ֭שְׁמַע דִּבְרֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֑ים וְ֝לִבְּךָ֗ תָּשִׁ֥ית לְדַעְתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: haṭ ’ā·zə·nə·ḵā ū·šə·ma‘ diḇ·rê ḥă·ḵā·mîm wə·lib·bə·ḵā tā·šîṯ lə·ḏa‘·tî
verses.literal: Incline your ear and hear the words of the wise apply your mind to my knowledge
verses.literalPt: Inclina o teu ouvido, e ouve as palavras do sábio, e aplica o teu coração ao meu conhecimento.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ נָ֭עִים כִּֽי־ תִשְׁמְרֵ֣ם בְּבִטְנֶ֑ךָ יִכֹּ֥נוּ יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו עַל־ שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- nā·‘îm kî- ṯiš·mə·rêm bə·ḇiṭ·ne·ḵā yik·kō·nū yaḥ·dāw ‘al- śə·p̄ā·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: for it is pleasing when you keep them within you . . . and they are constantly on your lips
verses.literalPt: Porque é coisa suave se os guardares dentro de ti, e forem eles presentes nos teus lábios.

verses.original: לִהְי֣וֹת בַּ֭יהוָה מִבְטַחֶ֑ךָ הוֹדַעְתִּ֖יךָ הַיּ֣וֹם אַף־ אָֽתָּה׃
verses.transliteration: lih·yō·wṯ Yah·weh miḇ·ṭa·ḥe·ḵā hō·w·ḏa‘·tî·ḵā hay·yō·wm ’ap̄- ’āt·tāh
verses.literal: So that your trust may be in the LORD I instruct you today yes you
verses.literalPt: Para que a tua confiança esteja em Jeová, a ti te quero, hoje, instruir.

verses.original: הֲלֹ֤א כָתַ֣בְתִּי לְ֭ךָ שִׁלְשׁוֹם בְּמ֖וֹעֵצֹ֣ת וָדָֽעַת׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō ḵā·ṯaḇ·tî lə·ḵā šil·šōm bə·mō·w·‘ê·ṣōṯ wā·ḏā·‘aṯ
verses.literal: Have I not written for you thirty sayings about counsel and knowledge
verses.literalPt: Porventura, não te escrevi coisas excelentes acerca dos conselhos e dos conhecimentos,

verses.original: לְהוֹדִֽיעֲךָ֗ קֹ֭שְׁטְ אִמְרֵ֣י אֱמֶ֑ת לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֲמָרִ֥ים אֱ֝מֶ֗ת לְשֹׁלְחֶֽיךָ׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·hō·w·ḏî·‘ă·ḵā qō·šəṭ ’im·rê ’ĕ·meṯ lə·hā·šîḇ ’ă·mā·rîm ’ĕ·meṯ lə·šō·lə·ḥe·ḵā
verses.literal: to show you true and reliable words that you may soundly answer those who sent you
verses.literalPt: para te fazer conhecer a certeza das palavras da verdade, a fim de que, em resposta, refiras palavras de verdade aos que te enviarem?

verses.original: אַֽל־ תִּגְזָל־ דָּ֭ל כִּ֣י דַל־ ה֑וּא וְאַל־ תְּדַכֵּ֖א עָנִ֣י בַשָּֽׁעַר׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiḡ·zāl- dāl kî ḏal- hū wə·’al- tə·ḏak·kê ‘ā·nî ḇaš·šā·‘ar
verses.literal: Do not rob a poor man because he is poor and do not crush the afflicted at the gate
verses.literalPt: Não roubes ao pobre, porque é pobre, nem oprimas ao aflito na porta,

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יְ֭הוָה יָרִ֣יב רִיבָ֑ם וְקָבַ֖ע אֶת־ קֹבְעֵיהֶ֣ם נָֽפֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- Yah·weh yā·rîḇ rî·ḇām wə·qā·ḇa‘ ’eṯ- qō·ḇə·‘ê·hem nā·p̄eš
verses.literal: for the LORD will take up their case and will plunder those who rob them . . .
verses.literalPt: pois Jeová pleiteará a causa deles e tirará a vida daqueles que os despojam.

verses.original: אַל־ תִּ֭תְרַע אֶת־ בַּ֣עַל אָ֑ף וְאֶת־ אִ֥ישׁ חֵ֝מוֹת לֹ֣א תָבֽוֹא׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tiṯ·ra‘ ’eṯ- ba·‘al ’āp̄ wə·’eṯ- ’îš ḥê·mō·wṯ lō ṯā·ḇō·w
verses.literal: Do not make friends with an angry man and do not associate with a hot-tempered man
verses.literalPt: Não te associes com o homem iracundo, nem andes com o homem colérico,

verses.original: פֶּן־ תֶּאֱלַ֥ף אָרְחָתוֹ וְלָקַחְתָּ֖ מוֹקֵ֣שׁ לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: pen- te·’ĕ·lap̄ ʾå̄·rə·ḥå̄·ṯō wə·lā·qaḥ·tā mō·w·qêš lə·nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: or you may learn his ways and entangle yourself in a snare
verses.literalPt: para que não aprendas as suas veredas e tragas a destruição sobre a tua alma.

verses.original: אַל־ תְּהִ֥י בְתֹֽקְעֵי־ כָ֑ף בַּ֝עֹרְבִ֗ים מַשָּׁאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tə·hî ḇə·ṯō·qə·‘ê- ḵāp̄ ba·‘ō·rə·ḇîm maš·šā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: Do not be one who gives pledges . . . who puts up security for debts
verses.literalPt: Não sejas dos que se comprometem e dos que servem de fiadores de dívidas.

verses.original: אִם־ אֵֽין־ לְךָ֥ לְשַׁלֵּ֑ם לָ֥מָּה יִקַּ֥ח מִ֝שְׁכָּבְךָ֗ מִתַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- ’ên- lə·ḵā lə·šal·lêm lām·māh yiq·qaḥ miš·kā·ḇə·ḵā mit·taḥ·te·ḵā
verses.literal: If you have nothing with which to pay why should your bed be taken from under you
verses.literalPt: Se não tens com que pagar, por que tiraria alguém a tua cama de debaixo de ti?

verses.original: אַל־ תַּ֭סֵּג גְּב֣וּל עוֹלָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֲבוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: ’al- tas·sêḡ gə·ḇūl ‘ō·w·lām ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Do not move an ancient boundary stone which your fathers have placed
verses.literalPt: Não removas o antigo marco que teus pais puseram.

verses.original: חָזִ֡יתָ אִ֤ישׁ׀ מָ֘הִ֤יר בִּמְלַאכְתּ֗וֹ לִֽפְנֵֽי־ מְלָכִ֥ים יִתְיַצָּ֑ב בַּל־ יִ֝תְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵ֥י חֲשֻׁכִּֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: ḥā·zî·ṯā ’îš mā·hîr bim·laḵ·tōw lip̄·nê- mə·lā·ḵîm yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣāḇ bal- yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣêḇ lip̄·nê ḥă·šuk·kîm
verses.literal: Do you see a man skilled in his work He will be stationed in the presence of kings he will not stand before obscure men
verses.literalPt: Vês tu a um homem perito na sua vocação? Este não assistirá perante homens obscuros.
